app.name: KSC Public Record Intelligence
app.tagline: Citation-first research over the public court record

language.label: Interface language
language.note: Switching changes the interface only. Document language is a property of each document.
language.provisional: Albanian legal terminology is provisional until checked against official KSC publications.

demo.description: Every figure on this screen is illustrative. In production every figure is a live read from the records database.

meaning.incident: An event alleged in the record
meaning.location: A place named in the record
meaning.organisation: A unit or body named in the record

direction.scopeNote: Direction is measured against the claim in the same row, not against any person.

provenance.boundary: Below this line: generated analysis, not the record
provenance.aiHeader: Written by software · no part of this is a court record

protection.title: Protected Witness
protection.body: This system holds only the public witness code. It stores or derives no identity attributes, and search will not resolve a name to this code.

referenceCounts.title: Record References
referenceCounts.disclaimer: How many times this appears in the record. Not a measure of significance, involvement or responsibility.

citation.unresolvedNotice: A citation on this surface could not be resolved to a page, paragraph or line range. The content that depended on it is withheld.

table.columnNote: Column values are record attributes. No column is a weight or an importance score.

states.partial: Partial data is shown. The gap is marked above.

gap.title: Not held in the public record

footer.neutrality: Every entry on this screen is a reference to the public court record. Nothing here is an assessment of any person.
footer.network: Connections represent relationships or references found in the public court record. A connection does not by itself imply wrongdoing, agreement, responsibility or guilt.
footer.referenceCounts: Reference counts state how many times something appears in the record. They are not a measure of significance, involvement or responsibility.
footer.sourceNote: Primary court sources, the database, provenance and citations are authoritative. AI output is analysis only.
footer.disclosure: Independent research tool — not an official KSC product and not legal advice. It uses public sources only; confidential, ex parte and private material is excluded. External public sources remain distinct from court evidence. Network links do not imply wrongdoing. AI analysis is not court record. Verify important citations against the original source. No analytics or third-party telemetry is enabled.

placeholder.absent: This screen has not been built yet.
placeholder.reason: It is scheduled for Phase 5 — implementing the approved design with mock data. The route, chrome and language switch are live; the content is not.
placeholder.notDesigned: No artboard — built from the Evidence Explorer table pattern

home.title: KSC Public Record Intelligence
home.subtitle: Explore the public record of KSC-BC-2020-06 — documents, transcripts, witnesses, exhibits, findings — with every claim traced to its source.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search the public record — a name, W01234, F01234, P00123, ¶1204 or free text
home.statsNote: Counts will be live database reads. Until ingestion begins they render as a dash, never as zero.
home.foundationNotice: Engineering foundation. No court documents have been ingested. Every section below opens its route; content arrives in later phases.
home.principle: Primary sources → database → structured evidence → provenance and citations → search, network and analysis → AI. The record is authoritative. AI is analysis only.

phase5.mockNotice: This workspace uses clearly labelled generic demo records. No court material has been ingested.
phase5.resultOrdering: Result ordering reflects textual relevance and record density only. It carries no assessment of any person or of the weight of any evidence.
phase5.searchedVariants: The mock repository searches identifiers, titles and sample text.
phase5.commandHint: Type a name, witness code, filing, exhibit or finding
phase5.question: Question
phase5.comparisonNeutral: This workspace compares wording and source coverage. It does not assess a witness.
phase5.pathBanner: These records reference one another. That is all a path shows.
phase5.pathLimit: A shorter path is not a stronger one. Paths are ordered by hop count only.
phase5.cannotTell: What a path cannot tell you
phase5.cannotRealWorld: That the two entities are connected in any real-world sense
phase5.cannotKnowledge: That either knew of, or is answerable for, the other
phase5.cannotSignificance: That a shorter path is more significant than a longer one
phase5.canTell: That these demo documents each mention the item next to them at the citation shown
phase5.sequenceNote: Placing two cards near each other shows only that they carry nearby dates. Sequence in time is not causation.
phase5.chargeNote: As charged in the Indictment — not a determination.
phase5.noPrediction: No predictive rating or outcome estimate is produced.
phase5.legalDecline: This system does not answer legal questions. Consult qualified counsel.
phase5.simpleIntro: Plain-language explanations appear with the official wording and citations they describe.
phase5.readSource: Where can I read the source?
phase5.doesNotMean: What this finding does not mean

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.identifierMissing: No record with the identifier {identifier} is in the public set.
notFound.reason: The identifier may be mistyped, or the record may exist but not be public. Those are different states and the system distinguishes them.
notFound.generic: There is no page at this address.

phase5b.demoDescription: Generic sample {kind} row generated for layout density. No court material.
phase5b.noMatchReason: The filters below narrow the demo set the most. Remove one to widen the result.
phase5b.columnMeaning: Column values are record attributes. 'Judgment' counts paragraphs citing the exhibit — it is not a weight or an importance score.
phase5b.searchSyntax: Syntax: W##### · F##### · P##### · D##### · ¶#### · "exact phrase" · free text
phase5b.rankingDisclaimer: Result ordering reflects textual match only. It carries no assessment of any person or of the weight of any evidence.
phase5b.realDataNotice: Real controlled-corpus record · other screens may still use labelled demo data.
phase5b.publicRoles: Public roles as stated in the record
phase5b.noScore: No score, rank, weight or probability about this person exists in this system.
phase5b.publicWitnessNote: Rendered only when an official public source identifies the witness.
phase5b.noPriorStatement: No prior public statement has been disclosed for this witness.
phase5b.silent: Prior statement silent on this topic.
phase5b.languageRule1: lying · dishonest · false · unreliable never appear in the system's voice.
phase5b.languageRule2: Where the Chamber made a credibility finding it is quoted, attributed and cited.
phase5b.chamberAssessment: This is the Chamber's assessment, not the system's.
phase5b.matrixNote: Direction is measured against the claim in the same row, not against any person.
phase5b.incidentFooter: Listing a person or a charge here records that the material exists — it is not an allegation by this system.
phase5b.emptyLane: No records in this layer for the selected filters
phase5b.dateMergeNote: A document's date and the date it was filed are never merged. Both are indexed separately.
phase5b.selectCard: Select a card to see every attached date.
phase5b.willNotDo: What this screen will not do
phase5b.willNot1: Predict how any court would rule.
phase5b.willNot2: Rank issues by strength or likelihood.
phase5b.legalStrip: This screen identifies questions in the record. It answers none of them and is not legal advice.
phase5b.emptyCategory: No issues surfaced in this category
phase5b.emptyCategoryReason: This reflects the pattern-matching pass over the demo set, not a judgment that none exist.
phase5b.noCitationsYet: No citations yet — every substantive sentence should resolve to a source.
phase5b.editorNote: The editor flags sentences with no supporting citation as you write. It does not evaluate whether the argument is correct.
phase5b.reviewerNote: The neutral reviewer reports gaps between the draft and the record. It does not say whether the argument should be made, nor predict how any court would receive it.
phase5b.askPlaceholder: Ask a research question about the public record
phase5b.retrievedFirst: Sources are retrieved and listed before any answer text renders.
phase5b.notAvailableBody: Closed sessions, redactions and untranslated material are reported as gaps, never filled.
phase5b.publicHero: Understand the case without simplifying the evidence.
phase5b.publicIntro: Every plain-language passage is shown together with the official text it explains, and every figure links to the public record.
phase5b.beforeBegin1: This site shows the public court record. It does not decide anything.
phase5b.beforeBegin2: Protected witnesses appear only as codes such as W01234.
phase5b.beforeBegin3: A connection between two names is a reference in the record, not an accusation.
phase5b.otherSide: There was also evidence pointing the other way
phase5b.noPathReason: No path may exist in the public record.
phase5b.citedBanner: This passage is cited by finding {ref}
phase5b.redactedPage: This page is redacted in the public version
phase5b.noContrary: No material in the record tends against this finding as stated.
phase5b.speaker: Speaker
phase5b.pendingSource: Pending — no source has been ingested
phase5b.hero: The public record, traceable to the line.

phase10.title: Finding evidence matrix
phase10.realDataNotice: Real controlled-corpus Court material. Source categories and unresolved gaps remain explicit.
phase10.aiNotGenerated: No AI analysis is generated in Phase 10.
phase10.relatedNotExplicit: Related; not explicitly cited by Court
phase10.noExplicitEvidence: No explicit evidence link is available
phase10.courtSummaryOnly: Court summary only. Underlying public filing {ref} is not held in this corpus.
phase10.noHumanNotes: No human note is attached to this finding.
phase10.noInference: A citation or network path is not proof that material supports a finding. No guilt, credibility, judicial-quality or outcome score is produced.

phase12.neutralFraming: Questions from verified public records for human legal review. This workspace does not decide error or predict an outcome.
phase12.noPrediction: No predictive score, probability, ranking or outcome estimate is produced.
phase12.noIssuesReason: This reflects the controlled record and review pass; it is not a conclusion that no issue exists.
phase12.ready: Citation checks pass; ready for human legal review.
phase12.notReady: Not ready for human legal review. Record gaps remain explicit.
phase12.willNotDo: What this screen will not do
phase12.willNotDoBody: It does not decide that the Panel was wrong, declare an appeal ground valid, assess credibility or predict success.
phase12.argumentLabNote: Research actions annotate the source-backed outline; they do not rewrite it or decide whether it is correct.
phase12.comparisonNeutral: The classification describes the two cited passages. It is not a credibility assessment.
phase12.noCredibilityInference: No witness is labelled dishonest or unreliable. Differences require human review.

media.title: External media and public statements
media.description: Lawfully public context kept structurally separate from the court record and court evidence.
media.boundary: Public availability does not make this material court evidence. A stronger court status requires an exact verified court citation.
media.noResults: No results in this source layer.

phase11.title: Citation-first research
phase11.description: Verified public sources are retrieved and shown before any answer. AI analysis is separate and never evidence.
phase11.questionPlaceholder: Ask a research question about the indexed public record
phase11.requestFailed: The research request failed safely. No answer was rendered.
phase11.sourcesBeforeAnswer: Sources are retrieved, validated and listed before answer text renders.
phase11.courtSummaryMissing: Court summary only; underlying {ref} is not held.
phase11.withheldBody: The controlled corpus did not provide enough validated support, or citation validation failed. No partial answer is shown.
phase11.emptyBody: The system will retrieve verified public sources first. If support is insufficient, it will abstain.
phase11.knownGapsBody: No public Trial Judgment; underlying F03743 and F03746 are not held. These gaps are never filled from model memory.

phase15.linkedRecordsUnavailable: No verified linked records are available for this item yet.
phase15.sourceBacked: Real public-record data with preserved provenance.
phase15.noSourceOccurrences: No verified source occurrences are linked to this record yet.
phase15.noWitnessContent: No public testimony segments or source-backed links are available for this witness yet.
phase15.protectedWitnessBoundary: The public record exposes this witness by code only. No private identity is inferred or displayed.
phase15.incidentBoundary: This page shows only a source-backed incident record; corpus proximity is not treated as proof.
phase15.noParsedCoordinate: No parsed public content is available at this coordinate.
phase15.sourceBackedOnly: Only source-backed search results are shown.

empty.people: No verified people have been linked to the public record yet.
empty.witnesses: No public witness records are available.
empty.incidents: No verified incidents have been linked to the public record yet.
empty.findings: No verified Court findings are available.

phase18.hearingsUnavailable: No hearing with a recorded public appearance is held for this witness. Hearing totals are shown only from stored transcript-header appearances, never estimated.
phase18.sourceNavigationHint: Search opens only public, source-backed occurrences and preserves available page, paragraph, or line coordinates.
phase18.unknownStatus: UNKNOWN — no admission, rejection, or tender status is established in the held public record.
phase18.readerContextUnavailable: No additional verified links are available for this document in the current API response.
phase18.matchedBy: Matched by source-backed text or identifier search
phase18.networkInitialLimit: Showing a bounded working set. Search, filter, or select a node to explore progressively.
phase18.networkCountsUnavailable: Counts in this inspector are computed from the currently loaded provenance-backed graph.
phase18.noDescription: No separate description is established in the held public record.
phase18.networkNoFocusedRecords: No provenance-backed relationships are available for this focused record.

phase19.reviewRequiredNote: These source labels identify only a surname or match more than one recorded person. They are not assigned to this person automatically.
phase19.searchMatchesNote: Lexical search results for this name or identifier. They are not verified mentions.
phase19.evidenceCount: {count, plural, one {# source anchor} other {# source anchors}}

appearances.title: Hearings with a recorded public appearance
appearances.summary: {hearings, plural, one {# hearing} other {# hearings}} · {rows, plural, one {# transcript version} other {# transcript versions}}
appearances.basis: Each row comes from the transcript's own page header naming this witness. A mention in the body text is not an appearance. Private and closed pages are counted from the header, never read, and gaps are never bridged.

statusHistory.title: Status history
statusHistory.basis: Status comes only from explicit statements by the bench or court officer. The date shown is the hearing in which the statement was made, which may be later than the ruling itself.
statusHistory.none: No court-record statement about this exhibit is held. The status is not inferred.

network.pageSummary: {total, plural, one {# relationship} other {# relationships}} match. Showing {shown} at a time; the full graph is never loaded.
network.overview: No entity is focused. This is one bounded page of evidence edges; search for a node or open the network from a dossier to focus it.

phase19.exactSourceOutside: The exact source text is on this page but outside the parsed paragraphs shown here (for example a running header, heading or footnote). Verbatim source text:

phase20.honestFallback: No exact PDF rectangle is available. Navigation uses the honest {precision} fallback; no highlight was manufactured.
phase20.pdfUnavailable: The original PDF could not be rendered
phase20.pdfCoordinateUnavailable: The original PDF is held, but this parsed coordinate does not resolve to a PDF page
phase20.derivativeTextNote: Parsed from the original PDF. Derivative aid — the PDF remains authoritative.
phase20.pageHeaderNote: States whose evidence this page belongs to. It does not identify any speaker label.
phase20.speaker: Speaker (verbatim label)
phase20.filteredNotice: Filtered view: {shown} of {total} matching segments. Surrounding source lines are hidden — open a segment to read it in full context.
phase20.closedSegment: Closed or private session — no public text for these lines.
phase20.noSegments: No parsed transcript segments on this PDF page.
phase20.noParsedText: No parsed text for this PDF page.
phase20.pdfClickHint: Select a line on the PDF to focus its transcript segment. Only validated line geometry responds.
phase20.noRegionDrawn: {precision}: navigated to the page and line; no rectangle was drawn.
phase20.relationshipNeutral: A relationship records documented source co-reference only. It implies no guilt, coordination, responsibility or credibility.
phase20.pageContextEmpty: No source-anchored research objects on this page.
phase20.contextTruncated: Showing the first items of each type; more exist on this page.
phase20.eventsUnsupported: Events are not source-anchored in this corpus.
phase20.ocrRequired: This page requires OCR — no native text geometry is available. The original PDF page remains viewable; no OCR text has been generated.
phase20.localSearchNote: Search matches are lexical hits, not verified mentions.
phase20.versionSwitchNote: Another version opens at its own first page. Highlights and coordinates are never carried across versions.
phase20.contextUnavailable: Research context could not be loaded for this page.
